lines: Anaykumar Avinash Joshi, Promoter, holds 591,000 shares and has a stake unlocked since an event on 9 Sep 2026.
The shares, valued at ₹79.90 crore (estimate, valued at offer price), are not cash; the unlock was 67 days ago.
Part of the holding stays locked until 9 Sep 2027, so more of their stake becomes tradable later.
Caveat: how many shares were unlocked is not extracted from the source.
